stage: concept stills for human review - no video, no H3, no FFmpeg

canvas.note: Vertical short-drama frame (same as training/drama.py). About 0.9 MP, the same pixel count the local card already handles at 1024x1024. H3 takes the image's own aspect ratio, so the master keeps this shape.

style_positive: realistic cinematic thriller still, photorealistic, natural skin texture, realistic human proportions, cinematic composition, 35mm film look, high environmental detail, realistic lighting, natural depth of field, professional film still
style_negative_extra: anime, cartoon, painting, exaggerated fantasy, overexposed, underexposed, pitch black, crushed blacks, distorted face, malformed hands, extra fingers
style_note: The user's 'no illustration / no anime / no cartoon' list lives in the negative prompt on purpose: written into a positive prompt, Z-Image tends to paint the words it is told to avoid.
lighting_rule: Master images keep information first. A night scene is lit by a plausible light source (lamp, screen glow, platform lights, street lights, rain reflections) with a readable background, never 'extremely dark'. Day / Sunset / Night variants come later, from the approved master.
composition_rule: Candidate A = cinematic composition, B = narrative composition (what the story information needs to read). Same character, location, costume, lighting and story information in both - only the framing differs. Candidates C / D are only made for a scene whose review says REGENERATE.

extra_compositions.C: slightly low camera angle, medium shot, the subject and the key story object both in frame
extra_compositions.D: eye-level medium close-up from a different side than the first two candidates, clean uncluttered background

seed_rule: seed = story.seed_base + scene * 10 + candidate_number (A=1, B=2, C=3, D=4). Reproducing an image needs the same seed AND the same width/height.
review_checklist: light is bright enough to see detail
video_potential_questions: Will the person deform when animated?
Are the hands a likely problem?
Is the action easy to describe?
Is the camera easy to move?
age_rule: Every person in every story is an adult (the character bibles say so). The tool never drops the project's age-safety negatives or the cfg 1.5 floor.
